content.short: BombPixel is a physics-based blockchain game where players design arenas, craft weapons, and battle online.
content.description: BombPixel tackles the issue of repetitive bomber-style gameplay by introducing unique characters, each with its own special abilities, which adds strategic depth to every match. Players engage in fast-paced battles, customize their favorite pixel heroes, and compete across a variety of game modes. Whether playing solo or challenging friends online, BombPixel delivers a fun, nostalgic experience that blends classic vibes with modern twists.
content.meta: BombPixel is a physics-based blockchain game for arena design, weapon crafting, and battles. Discover BombPixel and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
